mapper.select: select t.batch_no, t.storeCount, t.startTime, t.endTime, t.syncUserId, su.nickname as syncUserName, t.params, t.status from ( select batch_no, count(store_id) as storeCount, min(start_time) as startTime, max(finish_time) as endTime, min(creator) as syncUserId, params, CASE -- 全部成功 WHEN COUNT(store_id) = SUM(IF(status IN (2), 1, 0)) THEN '完成' -- 全部失败 WHEN COUNT(store_id) = SUM(IF(status IN (3), 1, 0)) THEN '全部失败' -- 部分成功（混合成功和失败） WHEN SUM(IF(status IN (1), 1, 0)) > 0 THEN '进行中' ELSE '部分成功' END AS status from commodity_sync_task ${ew.customSqlSegment} group by batch_no ) t left join system_users su on su.id = cast(t.syncUserId as unsigned) order by t.startTime desc
